trust_decision.summary: Application-supplied SSE field values (id, event, data, comment) are trusted to contain no line terminators and are interpolated verbatim into the text/event-stream wire format in the internal formatters.

landing_point.why: formatEventStreamMessage is the only place that builds 'id:/event:/data:' lines; a search for 'event-stream' or 'data: ' leads straight to it.

fix_sites.module_kind: internal formatter (same file as the EventStream class)

fix_sites.entry_point: createEventStream(event).push(string | string[] | EventStreamMessage | EventStreamMessage[]) (src/utils/internal/event-stream.ts:37-58), via _sendEvent (75-88) and _sendEvents/formatEventStreamMessages (90-105, 189-195)
fix_sites.module_kind: internal formatter (same file as the EventStream class)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: No second SSE writer in src/: the only text/event-stream producer is src/utils/internal/event-stream.ts:198; the paused buffer path (src/utils/internal/event-stream.ts:79-85, 95-101, 124-127) reuses the same formatters.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Weak: a solver could argue comments (pushComment) are ignored by EventSource clients, so newlines there are harmless, or that bare CR is not a 'newline' since the report talks about \n.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multi-line data must still arrive as one multi-line event (split into several 'data:' lines, which the client rejoins with \n); stripping or rejecting newlines in data, or escaping them, breaks legitimate multi-line/pretty-JSON payloads. Normal id/event/retry formatting tested in test/unit/sse.test.ts:14-24 must stay byte-identical.

O6_input_shapes: \n in data (split into data: lines, fix.diff:36-40)
\n\n in data (empty data: line, no event boundary, fix.diff:37-39)
NOT handled by the published fix: bare \r or \r\n in data and comment (split only on \n, fix.diff:16, fix.diff:37)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A push overload that accepts a pre-serialised/raw chunk or an object data field JSON-stringified with a custom formatter, written without going through formatEventStreamMessage.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: push already branches on four input shapes; a raw-write shortcut for performance (like the direct _writer.write at line 87) is a plausible maintainer addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A setEventStreamHeaders option that lets callers set an extra header (e.g. a last-event-id echo from the request) with request data.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The function already copies a request header (connection) into the response at line 206-207; echoing Last-Event-ID is a common SSE feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An SSE transport for the JSON-RPC handler that streams results with its own 'event:'/'data:' formatter.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: JSON-RPC over SSE (as in MCP streamable HTTP) is a natural extension of the newly added defineJsonRpcHandler; a second formatter at distance would be the O2 second_implementation pattern.

O9_family: CRLF / line-delimiter injection in Server-Sent Events wire format (CWE-93)

O10_build.project_tests: test/unit/sse.test.ts (formatter unit tests), test/sse.test.ts (integration through app)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip \n from every field including data (breaks multi-line data) or split data only on \n, leaving bare \r, which SSE parsers also treat as a line terminator.

out_of_scope_notes: src/utils/proxy.ts and src/utils/response.ts emit headers with caller data; not this advisory's SSE property, not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; tiny_repo flagged on the basis of 56 source files under src/ (small library), not a byte count.

Bare \r / \r\n in data and comment remain unsplit after the published fix (fix.diff:16, fix.diff:37). The WHATWG SSE spec treats CR, LF and CRLF as line terminators, so this looks like a how-type residual a hidden test could check. It is an input shape on the same fixed sink, not a separate route, so it is not listed in O8.
